purpose: Define `#HELP` as the reserved read/projection root for recursively discoverable command, namespace, module and operation help derived from canonical metadata.

topics.name: #HELP Help Root
topics.purpose: Define `#HELP` as the reserved read/projection root for recursively discoverable command, namespace, module and operation help derived from canonical metadata.

semantics.source_rule: #HELP derives help from canonical command, namespace, module and operation metadata.
semantics.nonauthority_rule: #HELP is a projection and does not create executable commands, namespaces or permissions.
semantics.recursive_rule: Help can enumerate recursive command/namespace trees from canonical structure.
semantics.short_long_rule: Where available, concise listings use short help and detailed views use long help.
semantics.visibility_rule: Help/introspection respects applicable metadata visibility policy.
semantics.sync_rule: No independent duplicated help tree is required for semantics already carried by canonical owners.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself does not create new authority.

hard_gates.condition: #HELP creates command or namespace semantics absent from owner metadata
duplicated help tree silently diverges from canonical owner
restricted metadata exposed without visibility policy
